newReleases.name: Storm Born Kicker Bolt N Ball
newReleases.desc:
A mysterious accident changes everything. While driving through the city, our hero gets caught in a sudden crash. But instead of ending his journey, the accident awakens an incredible power within him the power of electricity!

Now, a simple ball is no longer just a ball. With every powerful kick, it can travel at lightning speed. Guided by a skilled trainer, master your new ability and prove that lightning can turn an ordinary kick into an unstoppable shot.

Swipe your finger across the screen to draw the perfect path for the ball. Aim carefully, control your direction, and let the player kick the ball with electrifying force. Score goals, overcome challenging obstacles, and use your lightning-powered kicks to complete each level on the road classes.

The journey takes place across dynamic city roads, where every level brings a new challenge. As you progress, the difficulty increases, demanding better aim, faster reactions, and smarter use of your special power.

newReleases.desc:

The game preserves the classic weapons and hunting experience the IP is known for, while introducing a brand-new world, original Adventurers, Buddies, and exclusive new Monsters.

④ Original Adventurers & Classic Weapons,
Unleash All-new Hunting Arts

newReleases.name: BLEACH Mirrors High
newReleases.desc:
Dive into BLEACH Mirrors High, an officially licensed game created in close collaboration with BLEACH creator Tite Kubo. Experience a brand new storyline set after the Thousand-Year Blood War. Meet a fresh cast of characters exclusively designed by the legendary mangaka, and stand alongside favorites like Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki, with in-game character voices from the original Japanese anime cast. 

Take your place as the protagonist, begin your journey as a Soul Reaper, and step into battle to experience the story as the Soul Reaper you've always wanted to be!

FORGE YOUR UNIQUE SOUL REAPER

newReleases.name: Emozle
newReleases.desc:
A little emoji. A lot of fun.

Emozle is a visual guessing game where a hint leads you to the right emoji in the right order. For the Daily Emozle, find five emoji in six guesses. Green means the right emoji in the right place, yellow means it belongs somewhere else, and gray means it is not in the answer.

A FRESH DAILY EMOZLE
Play a new Emozle every day, build your streak, collect medals, and share your result without revealing the answer.

DISCOVER SOCIAL
Discover creators, follow your favorites, play their Emozle, and create your own for others to enjoy.

THREE KIDS MODES
Beginner: match a sequence of three pictures.
Advanced: use a hint to find four emoji in five tries.
Expert: solve a five-emoji Emozle using a written hint.
Kids modes are free and work offline in the app. Advanced and Expert answers use alphabetical order by English emoji name.

CATCH UP IN THE ARCHIVE
Missed a Daily Emozle? Pick a day and play.

CHALLENGE FRIENDS
Create your own Emozle with a hint and five emoji, then share it privately with friends.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Collect gold, silver, and bronze medals and follow your results across game modes.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Start playing without an account. Sign in to save and sync supported progress and use account features.

OPTIONAL EMOZLE+
Emozle is free to download. Some features have limits, with optional rewarded ads where available. Emozle+ is a one-time purchase that removes ads and unlocks additional access. No subscription.

newReleases.name: Japanese Quest 1900
newReleases.desc:
Build your Japanese knowledge one short quest at a time.

Japanese Quest 1900 turns Japanese practice into a calm learning adventure, with 1,900 multiple-choice questions and English explanations. Work through 190 stages of 10 questions each, earn XP, and keep moving at your own pace.

EXPLORE THREE LEARNING WORLDS
• Hiragana: 200 questions to practise everyday words and simple sentences.
• Kanji: 500 questions about compounds, meanings and readings.
• Grammar: 1,200 questions, with study guides from N5 foundations through N3.

LEARN FROM EACH ATTEMPT
Read explanations after every answer. Missed questions join your personal review collection, so you can practise what needs another look. Save an unfinished round and resume later.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Earn XP, build answer combos, collect stage stars and follow your practice history. There are no countdown timers or lives to lose.

PRACTISE OFFLINE
All learning content is included. No account, advertising, analytics, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Learning records stay on your device. Export a JSON backup through the iOS share sheet, or import an existing backup when you choose.

CHOOSE YOUR COMFORT
Adjust larger text, stronger contrast, reduced motion and answer-choice shuffling in Settings.

The interface and explanations are in English. Japanese text appears in the exercises. Intended for English-speaking Japanese learners aged 13 and over.

newReleases.name: Spore Cellar
newReleases.desc:
Spore Cellar is a cosy idle game about growing a fungus farm in a dark stone cellar. Placement is everything.

Tap the mother cap to gather spores, then spend them on mushrooms for your beds. Every fungus has its own rule: some feed their neighbours, some need company, some glow only at night, some want to be buried. Find the layout where they all lift each other up, and watch the spores pour in.

GROW
• 16 hand-drawn pixel-art fungi, from Button Caps to Honey Fungus
• Each one boosts, needs or competes with the plots around it
• Dig your cellar from 3 × 3 out to 11 × 11
• Ripen fungi up to level 100 and breed stronger strains
• Day and night change what grows best

RELEASE AND COME BACK STRONGER
• Release the bloom to start fresh with a permanent bonus
• Spend spore essence in a 44-upgrade spore tree across 7 branches
• Watch your mother cap grow through 128 forms

DISCOVER
• Rare mutations: Albino, Azure and Golden
• Fill the 48-slot Mutation Book and 117 Field Journal entries
• Shoo hungry beetles and burst ripe puffballs

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Press and hold to keep tapping, drag to rearrange, pinch to zoom
• Plays upright or sideways on iPhone and iPad
• Your cellar keeps growing while you're away
• Fully offline. No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts.

newReleases.name: Crimini da Gabinetto
newReleases.desc:
CRIMINI DA GABINETTO
Gialli brevi per la pausa più importante della giornata.

Lo sappiamo tutti: il bagno è il posto dove si pensa meglio. E allora perché sprecare quei minuti a scorrere il telefono? Mentre fai la cacca, risolvi un crimine.

Ogni caso si legge e si chiude in 5-7 minuti: il tempo di una seduta. Nessun cronometro, nessuna fretta. Leggi la storia, osserva i personaggi, trova l'indizio. Quando ti alzi, il colpevole ha un nome.

LE INDAGINI DI NUNZIA VARRIALE
Trentotto anni a insegnare greco hanno insegnato a Nunzia Varriale, detta 'a Prufessurè, una cosa: la gente, se la lasci parlare, prima o poi dice tutto. Tu segui le sue indagini e provi ad arrivare alla verità prima di lei.

COME SI GIOCA
• Leggi il caso: un racconto breve, scritto per essere letto tutto d'un fiato.
• Conosci i sospettati e annota i tuoi sospetti nel taccuino.
• Accusa il colpevole e scegli la prova che lo inchioda.
• Bloccato? Chiedi un indizio, oppure arrenditi e leggi la soluzione.
• Scopri dove si nascondeva l'indizio, rileggendolo direttamente nel racconto.

NON SOLO GIALLI
Ogni caso finisce con curiosità sui luoghi e sulle tradizioni, le parole del dialetto e un proverbio da portarsi via.

COME FUNZIONA
• I primi 5 casi sono gratuiti.
• Con un acquisto unico sblocchi l'intero fascicolo della città: 20 nuovi casi e l'Epilogo.
• Nessun abbonamento, nessuna pubblicità.
• I casi sbloccati restano tuoi e si leggono anche offline.
• Altre città sono in preparazione.

newReleases.name: ForeHints - Fun Guessing Game
newReleases.desc:
ForeHints is a lively forehead guessing game for friends and family. Choose a deck, set the timer, hold your iPhone to your forehead and let everyone else give you clues. Tilt down when you guess correctly or tilt up to skip.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Choose from dozens of decks, including Kids, Animals, Celebrities, Songs, Capitals, Countries, Brands, Superheroes, Video Games and regional football leagues.
• Select rounds from 45 seconds to 5 minutes.
• Use motion controls or switch to accessible on-screen Correct and Skip buttons.
• Hear countdown, start and final-seconds sound cues, with optional vibration.

LANGUAGE AND REGION
Play in English, French or Modern Standard Arabic. Select the United Kingdom, France or Morocco as your game region for culturally relevant cards and a regional football deck. Arabic includes full right-to-left support. Language and region can be chosen independently.

MADE FOR PLAYING TOGETHER
ForeHints works completely offline after installation. There are no accounts, advertisements, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Your settings stay on your device and the app does not collect personal data.

Gather your friends, choose a deck and see how many hints you can turn into correct answers before time runs out.

newReleases.name: Ghost Bite
newReleases.desc:
Which tooth will make the ghost bite?

Ghost Bite is a suspenseful tooth-tapping game set in a world of vintage Thai horror illustrations. Tap one tooth at a time and see how long your luck lasts.

• 10 upper teeth and 10 lower teeth that sink and disappear when pressed
• Choose 1–5 cursed players to set the number of bites before the game ends
• Distinct dangerous teeth are chosen once at the start, matching the cursed-player count
• After a bite, pressed teeth stay down. Continue with the remaining teeth until all cursed players have been bitten
• Straw dolls turn monochrome with a chalk strike to show each bite
• Play in Thai, English, Japanese or Traditional Chinese
• Layered scenes respond to device tilt, with drifting dust, candlelight and gently moving water
• Switch music, sound effects and tilt effects on or off independently

Play offline on iPhone and iPad. No account, ads or in-app purchases.

Contains frightening ghosts, teeth, red gums, illustrated blood and sudden bite effects.

newReleases.name: BOOP: Pet Ripples
newReleases.desc:
You never touch your pet. You touch the world.

BOOP is a one-touch physics puzzle with real, living waves. Tap the water and a ripple spreads out, bounces off walls and pushes your pet toward the glowing ring. Tap behind to push, tap ahead to slow down, and time two taps so their waves stack into one big surge.

THREE WORLDS, THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Water: ripples glide across a sparkling pond, past fish and lily leaves.
• Land: stomp the meadow and send a shockwave through the grass. Waves fade fast, so every stomp counts. Hop past hedges, mushrooms and berry bushes.
• Sky: gusts travel far and push gently. Fly through the clouds, dodge storm eyes and reach the rainbow.
Each world has its own levels, its own difficulty and its own progress.

SIX CUTE COMPANIONS
Play as a cat, dog, bunny, panda, frog or the classic orb. Each one has its own look, voice and moves: cats and dogs run on four legs, bunnies and frogs hop, and everyone sprouts wings in the sky. Change their colour any time.

FULL 3D MODE
Switch to 3D and follow your pet with a chase camera, orbit around the level or look down from above. Drag to look around, pinch to zoom.

LEVELS THAT NEVER END
Every level is generated fresh and gets a little harder as you go, so there is always another one. A new Daily level arrives every day for everyone to try.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• Real-time wave physics, not canned animation
• Satisfying sounds and haptics on every boop
• Stars, points and streaks for clean solutions
• Pick any

newReleases.name: Words from Earth
newReleases.desc:
A little signal. A little friend.

Far from Earth, a lonely little alien hears something unexpected: a message made of letters. Connect them into English words, reveal small wonders from Earth, and help two distant strangers find someone to share their day with.

Words from Earth is a cozy word puzzle with a warm story about loneliness, kindness, and friendship across the stars.

100 little signals, 10 heartfelt chapters
Trace or tap letters to discover words. Each decoded word reveals a picture on the alien's screen and a curious reaction, with charming alien sounds and English subtitles. Complete each chapter to piece together a new letter.

A quiet world to spend time in
There is no timer. Enjoy a colorful, hand-drawn atmosphere, gentle music that changes with every chapter, soft chimes, and echoing alien chatter inspired by ASMR. Play at your own pace and use hints when you need a little help.

Little discoveries worth keeping
Find real English words beyond the puzzle answers and collect them in your Hidden Words Album. Earn one to three stars per signal, revisit earlier puzzles, and replay each chapter's short alien film after finishing it.

A story that grows closer
Ordinary Earth things become extraordinary through someone else's eyes. Behind the transmissions is a person with something simple to share. Follow ten letters toward a tender ending.

Pasla is a party game platform you can play with friends — pass one phone around in the same room, or play online with everyone on their own phone.

In Single Phone mode, you pass one device around the table. In Online mode, share a room code and join the same game in seconds — everyone from their own phone, anywhere.

- Mole: Find the spy among you, or guess the secret word without being caught as the spy.
- Curse: Secretly complete your assigned tasks and survive without getting caught.
- Fake Brush: Everyone draws the same picture, but one of you has a different word — can you spot the fake artist?
- Sync: Humans trying to survive the night against robots with hidden roles.
- Forbidden Emoji: Describe the word to your team using only emoji, without the banned ones!

WHY PASLA?
- No setup, no cards, start in seconds
- Practice solo against bots
- Badges, avatars and profile customization
- Regularly updated word packs

Invite your friends, pick a mode, and start the fun right away!

Every month someone walks into your office with a problem. You have two options and one swipe.

Swipe left or right to decide — and keep four things in balance: your team, your money, your investors and your clients. Let any of them drop to zero and you’re fired. Let any of them hit the top and you’re fired too.

newReleases.name: ABG Prime: Maths Journey
newReleases.desc:
The scrolls of the great Library of Alexandria are lost in time. Euclid, who wrote his Elements in Alexandria, needs a scribe to travel through history and find them—and every scroll is won with math.

ABG Prime turns daily math practice into a journey through the history of mathematics. Walk the road from era to era, meet the people who counted and measured thousands of years ago, and solve problems along the way.

THE JOURNEY
• Begin in ancient Egypt around 1550 BCE, when scribes counted the grain after every Nile flood, and travel on to the tablet house of Babylon. More eras of math history are on the way.
• Every task earns XP. Level up, find scrolls, and uncover each era's picture piece by piece.
• Scrolls bring new outfits and items for your traveler.
• The weekly board shows travelers by their scribe names only, and anyone can hide from it in Settings.

• Tasks follow the Finnish math curriculum, currently at a 5th-grade level: large numbers and place value, mental and written addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, units of measurement, and word problems.

• Two tries for every task. After a second miss, you see what went wrong and a step-by-step solution.
• Euclid suggests the next topic, favoring what you've practiced least and where you've made mistakes.
• A scratchpad for working things out with your finger.

newReleases.name: Super Bean Boy
newReleases.desc:
SWIPE TO FART
• Swipe up to fly, then steer through the gaps
• Blast-jump through blocked doors, even mid-flight
• Flick sideways to dash through walls
• Swipe down in mid-air for Toot-Time: the world slows to a crawl while you aim every toot

Every bean boosts your bending in its own way. Baked beans keep the gas coming. Butter beans shrug off explosions. Others give endless gas, toots that home in on their target, and more. Drink a potion mid-run and every special bean you eat fires at full power.

BOSSES, SKUNKS AND EXPLOSIONS
Take on Gary and his toilet drones, the bouncing Puppy Poopy and the bean-gobbling Bean Bin. Free the caged skunks before each boss, and once you have saved enough, call them in to fart alongside you. Set off TNT, nitro, blizzard and candy blasts all the way up.

PLANT YOUR FLAG
Every world belongs to whoever plants a flag on it, and their trail paints the ground everyone else climbs on. Climb past a rival's flag to take their world, then stand drones on your own to defend it.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Collect fart trails, from country flags to ones you draw yourself
• Pick a hat, and wear lucky pants to find more special beans
• Cook potions in your kitchen to level up your fart bending and your beans
• Come back for daily challenges and a 28-day streak

CLIMB THE BOARDS

Colorful sand is stacked in layers, and every bus has its own color and direction. Tap the right bus, collect the matching sand, and clear the board step by step. Sounds simple at first, but every move can change the whole puzzle.

• Tap a bus to move it along its route
 • Match each bus with the same color sand
 • Clear lower sand layers to unlock the ones above
 • Avoid traffic crashes when paths cross
 • Solve each level with smart sequencing
Why you’ll enjoy Jam Bus: Sandfall
• Easy tap controls
 • Relaxing color-matching gameplay
 • Clever bus parking jam puzzles
 • Satisfying sand-clearing effects
 • Increasingly tricky routes and layers
 • Clean visuals and smooth puzzle flow
 • Great for quick breaks and brain training

updates.name: Colony Flow!
updates.desc:
Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
- Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

- One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
- Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
- No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
- Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
- Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals, fruit, food, flowers, nature, festivals, toys, rockets, castles, and plenty more s

updates.name: Township
updates.desc:
BUILD YOUR DREAM TOWN!

Welcome to Township, a thrilling city-building and farming game where you become the mayor of your own town!
Build houses, factories, and community buildings, grow crops on your farm, and decorate your town just the way you like. Take part in limited-time events, compete in exciting regattas, and earn exclusive prizes!
